t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Each colour gnome is linked to different coloured baskets, try to figure out which gnome is linked to which colour. Pay attention to the x5 point multipliers and when your points start decreasing switch out to a different colour gnome, particularly in the point multiplier rounds!

vb_textbox.text: Each coloured Gnome is linked to either a yellow or red basket. Figure out what colours of Gnome are linked to the yellow or red baskets. The red or yellow baskets usually take turns of handing out more points than the other for periods. Stick with the basket colour which is handing out more points until it starts giving less points, then just switch over to the other colour basket. Make use of the x5 point multiplier rounds.
